departures.feature: body is a long, flat sac with translucent skin, not a feathered bird body
two pairs of membrane vanes instead of feathered wings
departures.quote: slung between two pairs of membrane vanes

departures.feature: vanes ribbed like a kite, stretched on hollow bone spars
departures.quote: ribbed like a kite and stretched on hollow spars of bone

departures.feature: a cluster of jointed, hook-tipped feeding limbs hanging below, folded around a radial mouth (no beak)
departures.quote: Below hangs a cluster of jointed, hook-tipped feeding limbs folded around a radial mouth

departures.feature: no head; a ring of dark pits along the leading edge instead of eyes
departures.quote: it has no head to speak of, only a ring of dark pits along the leading edge
